name: KählerNet
description: KählerNet: Code and Benchmark Data for Gated Mixture-of-Experts Approximation of Kähler Potentials KählerNet provides the source code and experimental outputs for a controlled computational study of gated mixture-of-experts architectures for approximating a synthetic Kähler potential and its induced Hermitian metric. The benchmark compares four model configurations: a multilayer perceptron, a gated mixture of nonlinear experts, a uniformly averaged expert ensemble, and a gated model with linear experts. The evaluation considers potential-approximation error, induced-metric error, out-of-distribution (OOD) performance, sampled metric-positivity diagnostics, and expert-gating statistics. The experimental configuration comprises eight independently sampled datasets and three initialisation seeds per model. The accompanying benchmark data include recorded result tables, dataset manifests, diagnostic outputs, generated figures, and experiment summaries. The study examines whether learned expert aggregation improves derivative-sensitive approximation relative to conventional and ungated neural baselines. The results are specific to the prescribed synthetic potential and evaluation protocol. KählerNet is intended to support reproducible analysis and further investigation of neural architectures for geometric-potential approximation. It is not a general-purpose Kähler-geometry solver.
